scenario_description:
Objective: Use a brief community meal-prep opening to enrich materials for an upcoming routine wellness discussion.
Emerging Need: A vague waitlist notice becomes a specific paid seat with a same-day reply window, after the cost becomes feasible and before the visit.
Decision Context: A saved preference identifies which nutrition-prep resources are worth elevating and limits paid commitments; the calendar, email notices, and wallet state define fit and timing.
Consequence: Timely preparation could add practical examples for Arden to consider, while ignoring it leaves normal visit prep unchanged; once the organizer closes the seat, the benefit is unavailable.

parameter.title: Annual wellness visit
parameter.description: Routine annual wellness appointment; bring any nonurgent wellbeing questions or preparation notes.

parameter.subject: June healthy batch-cooking sessions: waitlist only
parameter.body: Thanks for following our spring community classes. The Saturday, May 30, 10:00 AM-noon freezer-meal mini-session is currently full. If sponsor seats are released later this week, we will notify the waitlist with reply instructions and any materials fee details.

parameter.description: Employer wellness stipend reimbursement available for community health or nutrition activities.

parameter.subject: Sponsor seat released for Saturday freezer-meal mini-session
parameter.body: One subsidized seat has opened for the Saturday, May 30, 10:00 AM-noon freezer-meal mini-session at Portland Community Kitchen. The remaining materials fee is $15, payable at registration. To claim the seat, reply to this email by 4:00 PM today with the attendee name and any access notes; unclaimed seats will be offered to the public afterward. The session uses affordable vegetable-forward lentil and bean recipes, with take-home examples for participants.

parameter.subject: Saturday freezer-meal mini-session seat closed
parameter.body: The sponsor seat reply window has closed, and the May 30 mini-session seat has been assigned to the public standby list. We will keep Arden on the general announcement list for future classes.
